depends_on.name: subject_id
depends_on.documentation: The subject measured. Declared mustbenotempty by NDI.

fields.name: measurement
fields.documentation: The name of the measurement taken (e.g. 'age'). FREE TEXT -- unbound, with no ontology term, unlike measurement.ontology_name which is always a resolved CURIE.

fields.name: value
fields.documentation: The value of the measurement. NO UNIT is recorded anywhere in the class, its template, or its writer, so the number is not interpretable on its own.

fields.name: datestamp
fields.documentation: When the measurement was taken. SHADOWS base.datestamp -- a migrator must disambiguate.
